spans.text: After successfully recovering the surviving T-Dolls, everyone is withdrawing towards Area S11.
We found forces under the command of S.F. Ringleader Gager during our withdrawal!
She's controlling a lot of troops, and we'll need to break through their defensive line if we want to go down this route!
...Hmm, there's no other choice, is there? Also, our current intel indicates that the enemy's defensive line isn't very solid.
Rather than face some other boss unit whose data we don't even have, at least this enemy is a known quantity.
...That's right...the AR Team once brought this data back.
I wonder what happened to M4A1 and the others...
...You're right! Now's not the time to think about this... At the very least, we should believe the voice in the transmitter.
We'll only have a chance to meet each other again if we survive. Commander, let's break through Gager's defensive line ASAP!
